name: DeckLink
author: TZV
description: DeckLink: use a Blackmagic DeckLink capture card as a webcam. Start and stop the virtual camera from the Omarchy bar and pick the card, input, video mode and pixel format, and optionally expose the embedded audio as a microphone. Tested on the DeckLink Mini Recorder only. Never auto-starts, so OBS and Resolve can keep the card.

barWidget.description: Left-click opens the settings panel; right-click starts or stops the virtual camera; middle-click refreshes.
